titles: Build a CLI Tool That Summarizes Meeting Notes With AI
Summarize Markdown Meeting Notes in 4 Seconds With AI
Python AI Summarizer With .env Key and Error Handling
publish.description: Watch how to build a tiny command line tool that summarizes markdown meeting notes with an AI model. You will see how to install the client, store the API key in a .env file, call the chat completions endpoint, and add a friendly error handler for missing files.

Install client and keep API key in .env
Call chat completions and print summary
Fix crash with friendly missing-file message
